when_to_pick: Many trees vote - pick it when the lowest error matters more than a simple explanation.
One coefficient per measurement, easy to read - pick it when direction of effect matters most.
Copies the average of 5 nearest wines - pick it only when scaling is careful and features stay few.
Fits a curved surface and ignores small errors - pick it when tuning time is available.
A flowchart of threshold rules - pick it when you need to show exactly how a score was reached.
Always predicts the average score - the bar every real model has to clear.
